verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents item merging, which combines multiple items into one group, so duplicate issues can be merged. Its Custom Fingerprinting Rules explicitly cover the case where the default algorithm combines occurrences that should be separate, so wrongly collapsed groups can be split by rule. missing for 10: evidence of retroactively splitting or unmerging an existing item (splitting is only shown as rule-based regrouping), detail on how merge and fingerprinting work in practice, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can merge issues that are really the same bug and split ones the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed

citations.quote: Item merging allows you to combine multiple items into one 'group' for easier management and more accurate metrics.
If our default grouping algorithm is separating occurrences that you would rather have combined or vice versa, then you can set up Custom Fingerprinting Rules.
